messages.subject: Grouping and summing challenge
parts:
I have longitudinal data for various entities that are themselves organized into groups, something like

day <- c(1,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,3)
group <- c("A","A","B","A","A","B","A","A","B")
entity <- rep(c("a","b","c"),3)
value <- c(5,12,7,4,8,9,13,4,5)
df <- data.frame(day,group,entity,value)

I'd like to use facet_wrap() to plot the A and B group data as line charts, with aes(x=day,y=value).

I failed to figure out how to do the grouping and summing inside ggplot, so I tried

dfcast <- data.frame(cast(df, day + group ~ ., fun.aggregate=sum))
colnames(dfcast) <- c("day","group","total")

(that I had to cast the result of cast as a data frame surprised me) and then

qplot(day, total, group=group,geom="line",data=dfcast)

That plots the data on one graph, but it does get the data right.  These next two examples seem closer to what I want, but they don't work:

## > qplot(day, total, geom="line",data=dfcast) +facet_wrap(~ group)
## Error in dim(out) <- c(1, nrow(.$facet_levels)) :
##   dims [product 2] do not match the length of object [0]

## > qplot(day, total, group=group,geom="line",data=dfcast) +facet_wrap(~ group)
## Error in dim(out) <- c(1, nrow(.$facet_levels)) :
##   dims [product 2] do not match the length of object [0]

Any tips on what to do differently?

Thanks,

Bill

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Grouping and summing challenge
parts:
colname "group" sometimes induce errors.
use other names:

dfcast$grp <- dfcast$group
qplot(day, total, geom="line",data=dfcast) +facet_wrap(~ grp)

--
